paper.title: Network Momentum across Asset Classes
paper.source_universe: 64 ratio-adjusted continuous futures across four asset classes

paper_settings.daily_volatility_variance: weighted population variance in Appendix A.2
paper_settings.graph_input: concatenated eight-feature observations over each trailing window
paper_settings.graph_zero_diagonal: stated in prose; absent from displayed Eq.4 constraints
paper_settings.regression: pooled OLS with eight features and intercept
paper_settings.regression_feature_standardization: remove mean and scale to unit variance
paper_settings.target: next-session return divided by signal-date daily volatility
paper_settings.validation: latest 10 percent of each pre-test training sample

user_direction.purpose: understand methodology for replication and testing
user_direction.window_interpretation: 2011 is the start of feature history used to learn networks; the first complete ensemble is around early 2016

proposed_equity_conventions.primary_question: Does GMOM improve on own-stock LinReg with matched causal cohorts and equity trading costs?
proposed_equity_conventions.multi_session_returns: simple adjusted-close endpoint ratios; frozen for first pilot
proposed_equity_conventions.common_ensemble_nodes: current PIT members with complete eight-feature histories over all 1260 trailing sessions
proposed_equity_conventions.pre_entry_price_history: allowed for currently eligible members; prior index membership throughout lookback is not required
proposed_equity_conventions.missing_data: no synthetic prices/returns; retain original membership and eligibility reasons
proposed_equity_conventions.validation_split_unit: chronological trading dates with all stocks of a date together
proposed_equity_conventions.validation_score: raw GMOM portfolio Sharpe; MSE retained as diagnostic; not specified by paper
proposed_equity_conventions.alpha_beta_scope: one shared pair for all ensemble windows; not specified by paper
proposed_equity_conventions.post_selection_refit: refit OLS/scaler on all complete pre-test examples
proposed_equity_conventions.proposed_portfolio_scale: lagged 60-span EWM strategy volatility; not specified by paper
proposed_equity_conventions.future_labels: never select signal-time membership or delete held positions

execution.graph_fit_scope: first anchor 2016-01-04; all five paper lookbacks, common 429 nodes, untuned alpha=beta=1

feature_choices.volatility: normalized EWM population standard deviation alpha=2/61, minimum 60 returns
feature_choices.macd_ema: recursive alpha=1/J, seeded at first admitted contiguous-run price
feature_choices.winsorization: current-inclusive normalized EWM population moments of raw features, halflife252, minimum1
feature_choices.gaps: reset all indicator and clipping state; no price or return filling

first_window_feature_and_network_pilot.hyperparameters: untuned engineering defaults; no validation selection
first_window_feature_and_network_pilot.solver: equivalent N-variable convex dual, SciPy damped Newton

first_window_close_review.admission: provisional internal consistency; not independent price confirmation
